title: Kuudra title screen
description: A resource pack that changes the title screen to be Kuudra-themed
body:
# Kuudra Title Screen
A resource pack that changes Minecraft's title screen to be themed around kuudra

## Features: 
- "Minecraft" title now says "Kuudra".
- "Java edition" text now says "Infernal edition".
- The background panorama shows the upper section of the Kuudra's Hollow.
- Multiple new splash texts.
- A secret feature

_Note that the 1.21.4 version might work for mutiple newer versions. If that's not the case  with future updates, i'll upload a new version._
